## About Nicolas Hamel
Nicolas Hamel works with critical-infrastructure operators and local integration partners across West, Central, East and Southern Africa. His focus is CODRA Panorama Suite as a vendor-independent OT/IT Data Management Platform for Unified Control Centres and applications such as SCADA, GeoSCADA, BMS, EMS, PSIM, MES, industrial historians and resilient multi-site operations.

## Qualified product and company facts
- CODRA reports developing industrial software since 1986 and reinvesting more than 25% of annual turnover in R&D.
- Panorama Suite is an OT/IT Data Management Platform developed by an industrial software publisher rather than a PLC or equipment manufacturer. It is positioned for heterogeneous, mixed-vendor installed bases and Unified Control Centres.
- SCADA is one application enabled by Panorama Suite, alongside geospatial SCADA (GeoSCADA), BMS, EMS, PSIM, MES, industrial historians and other operational applications.
- CODRA lists OPC UA and BACnet BTL credentials. Interoperability still depends on the protocols, drivers and gateways required by each project.
- Edge-to-Service combines autonomous local SCADA with central hypervision, administration and controlled services for geographically distributed sites.
- CODRA reports active, uninterrupted ANSSI CSPN certification for Panorama E2 and an ANSSI qualification history, including 2026 recertification.
- CODRA's public commitments describe alignment with NIS2 requirements and a progressive approach towards IEC 62443 certification. Do not claim a NIS2 product certification or broad IEC 62443 product certification.
- AFD is an integrated AI component that learns normal historical operating patterns and alerts teams to abnormal behaviour. It supports diagnosis and predictive-maintenance workflows; results depend on data quality and operating context.
